en: Yesterday: two doors, one lion, and only one question.
Here's the question that saves your life.
Ask either guard: If I asked the other guard which door leads outside, which door would he point to?
If you asked Person 1, the truth-teller, he honestly repeats the lie of the liar.
If you asked Person 2, the liar, he lies about the truth-teller's answer.
Either way, they both point to the lion door.
So you take the other door, and walk out free.
Someone broke the old blue vase this morning. And one person in this house is lying.
It had been raining since sunrise. Heavy rain. All morning.
Person 1 says: I was reading in the garden the whole time.
Person 2 says: I was in the kitchen, baking bread.
Person 3 says: I was asleep upstairs. I only woke up when I heard the crash.
Look closely. One of them just gave themselves away.
Who is lying? Comment 1, 2 or 3. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
